label: LLM Gateway patch: provider llmgateway, baseURL https://api.llmgateway.io/v1, api openai-completions, key LLMGATEWAY_API_KEY, model deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017, default reasoningEffort max.
OpenCode Go patch: provider opencode-go, baseURL https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1, api openai-completions, key OPENCODE_API_KEY, model deepseek-v4.1-flash, default reasoningEffort max.
Both patches declare compat thinkingFormat deepseek and supportsDeveloperRole false, with the same off/high/max effort ladder and max as default.
They disagree on provider id, endpoint, key variable and exact model id; the OpenCode Go patch says its endpoint is unverified until a keyed run proves it.
The patches are alternative pins, not additive: both target llm-pi-ai and agent-default-model, and the repository says a dispatch passes exactly one route patch.
